name: Ravaged Twilight Camp
summary: In the Crystal Vale of northwestern Silithus, Ravaged Twilight Camp lies broken and quiet. Highlord Demitrian remains there alone, devoted to the Windseeker.

sections.title: A Hermit's Ruin in the Vale
sections.body: Twilight's Hammer keeps outposts across Silithus, yet its broken camp in the Crystal Vale is quiet and nearly deserted. Highlord Demitrian remains among the stones. He serves Thunderaan and broods over elemental bindings and the Windseeker's lost power, apart from the wider Twilight hierarchy.

faq.q: What is the Ravaged Twilight Camp?
faq.answer: Ravaged Twilight Camp lies in ruins in the Crystal Vale of northwestern Silithus. Highlord Demitrian makes his home there.

aliases: who is at the ravaged twilight camp
faq.answer: Highlord Demitrian is the camp's sole notable resident. He is tied to elemental lore and the bindings of Prince Thunderaan.
Cult records describe the camp as ruined. Highlord Demitrian remains among the wreckage, apart from Twilight's Hammer forces elsewhere in Silithus.

faq.q: Is the Twilight's Hammer hostile here?
faq.answer: No aggressive Twilight's Hammer patrols are in the camp. Unlike the camps across southern and central Silithus, it leaves Highlord Demitrian to brood in peace.

angles.text: As a warrior seeking rumors of Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker, your path leads to Highlord Demitrian in this forsaken camp.
As a paladin seeking the legendary elemental armaments of antiquity, seek Demitrian in the Crystal Vale to unravel the vessel of Prince Thunderaan.
